name: Coherence Monitoring Circuit
short_description: Integrates cross-modal prediction errors, temporal consistency signals, and spatial coherence indices to detect conflicts and generate behavioral adjustment signals.

components.name: XMOD_PE_INTEGRATOR
components.description: Aggregates cross-modal prediction errors from visual, auditory, and proprioceptive channels

components.name: TEMPORAL_CONSISTENCY_CHK
components.description: Monitors temporal alignment and consistency of events across modalities

components.name: CONFLICT_SIGNAL_GEN
components.description: Generates conflict signal when integrated PE and temporal measures diverge from spatial coherence

scope_conditions: Sufficient neural resources for cross-modal binding
key_references: Friston, K. (2010). The free-energy principle: A unified brain theory? Nature Reviews Neuroscience, 11(2), 127–138.
Talsma, D., Senkowski, D., Soto-Faraco, S., & Woldorff, M. G. (2010). The multisensory brain: Cross-modal integration of competing signals. Trends in Cognitive Sciences, 14(4), 145–159.
design_implications: Environmental designs should ensure temporal and spatial alignment of multisensory cues (e.g., synchronized audio-visual feedback in interactive installations)
Coherence conflicts may increase cognitive load; minimize conflicting cross-modal information in wayfinding systems
